# GreatOhm

> GreatOhm (https://www.greatohm.com/) is the world's first Omni app for all occult sciences, built by GREATOHM (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED. One account, one app: Vedic astrology (kundli, dashas, horoscopes, Panchang, Shubh Mahurat), numerology (life path, Lo Shu Grid, name and mobile number), Vaastu Shastra, palmistry, tarot and oracle readings, Nakshatra analysis, Sade Sati, Manglik Dosha and Lal Kitab remedies — plus the proprietary daily 360 degree **Ohm Score**.

Live on Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.greatohm.mobileapp (iOS coming soon). Support: support@greatohm.com. In-app translations across 26 locales.

For the full unabridged reference (every feature, remedy and FAQ answer), see https://www.greatohm.com/llms-full.txt
